protocol: additional normal-only trained reconstruction baseline; not few-shot

config.geometry: same PIL bicubic short-edge resize and bottom/right crop as template baseline
config.decoder: transposed convolutions; no skip connections; sigmoid RGB output
config.calibration: first 20 official sorted normal training files, excluded from fit and validation

map_storage: float32 working-size NPZ; original-size bilinear restore
score: top ceil(1%) mean of RGB absolute reconstruction residual, Gaussian sigma=2
